## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the --exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, you still archive matching logs because the default is always `[]`. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11). — CI jobs that configure exclusions through the environment cannot prevent matching files from entering the archive.
